<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

flowspace3 gains first-class ingestion of agent conversations from the native telemetry stores (req-0027, extending the req-0024..0026 surface). Input is either (pij_id, folder) or (session_id, harness, folder). Parsers live INSIDE flowspace, in Rust (Jordan ruling 2026-08-28): four store readers behind one frozen ConversationSource trait, an incremental byte-offset cursor service, and a normalizer to the measured turn payload, composed into `flowspace3 conversations ingest` which appends iteratively through the existing idempotent import. A thin harness extension wraps the command for now; the harness later calls it natively. Extraction recipe: scratch/reconstruct/09-ingestion-recipe.md (xoxarle, verified on this machine); payload spec: scratch/conversations-telemetry-sample.md; reconvo.py is the reference oracle the Rust readers are verified against. This plan is dogfood run #1 of the pij-team pipeline (impl-guide.dd.json in this folder is binding for the decomposition).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Ingest any local agent conversation by pij id or native session id into the conversations index, repeatably and incrementally.
- First-class Rust parsing of the git-ai/native session stores inside flowspace (no python runtime dependency).
- Append-only re-polling: a second ingest run lands only new turns, driven by durable byte-offset cursors.
- Prove the pij-team working model: frozen contracts, parallel SRP services, composition as wiring.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Live/streaming capture (daemon-side tailing, POST /conversations) — a later plan; this is pull-based ingest on demand.
- Roll-up summaries or error promotion (v1.1, Jordan-gated).
- Ingesting stores on other machines or retention management of the native stores.
- Harness-native ingestion (the harness absorbs this later; v1 ships a thin extension wrapper).
